positions.statement: On his campaign priorities page, Wagner says he has worked to keep firearms out of schools and create strong standards for safe storage of firearms.
positions.excerpt: I’ve worked to keep firearms out of schools, create strong standards for safe storage of firearms,

verification.note: Verbatim including the curly apostrophe in 'I’ve' (checked against the page). Sentence continues past the trailing comma ('and was chief author and sponsor of the legislation that created the Task Force on Community Safety and Firearm Suicide Prevention'); statement does not claim that part.

positions.statement: In a March 2023 Senate President press release on the housing and homelessness package, Wagner said 'we' worked across the aisle and with House and Governor's office partners toward available, affordable housing for everyone.
positions.excerpt: Faced with a statewide housing and homelessness crisis, we worked across the aisle and with our partners in the House and Governor's office to put Oregon on a path toward a future where housing is available and affordable for everyone.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Office of the Senate President (oregonlegislature.gov/wagner)

verification.note: Quote confirmed in the March 21, 2023 press release (Office of the Senate President; text extracted from the PDF locally because WebFetch could not read it). Statement said 'the Legislature worked'; the quote says 'we worked across the aisle and with our partners in the House and Governor's office'. Reworded to the speaker's own framing and the release's subject; year retained.

positions.statement: In a March 2022 statement as Senate Majority Leader, Wagner said he was excited about a $132 million behavioral health workforce investment and directing $333 million toward evidence-based programs for opioid use disorder and other behavioral health issues.
positions.excerpt: I’m excited about our recent $132 million investment in behavioral health workforce and our action to direct $333 million in incoming funds towards evidence-based programs to treat opioid use disorder and other behavioral health issues.

source.url: https://www.oregonlegislature.gov/senatedemocrats/Documents/Senate Majority Leader Rob Wagner Statement on Adjournment of the 2022 Legislative Session.pdf

verification.note: Quote confirmed in the March 4, 2022 press release (Senate Majority Leader statement, 2022 session adjournment). Statement dropped the $132 million behavioral health workforce figure and 'and other behavioral health issues'. Reworded to the full excerpt; year retained.

positions.statement: In a March 2022 statement as Senate Majority Leader, Wagner said the session made targeted investments to drive down everyday costs, including addressing child care costs by stabilizing Oregon's child care workforce.
positions.excerpt: addressing child care costs by stabilizing Oregon’s child care workforce.

source.url: https://www.oregonlegislature.gov/senatedemocrats/Documents/Senate Majority Leader Rob Wagner Statement on Adjournment of the 2022 Legislative Session.pdf

verification.note: Quote confirmed in the March 4, 2022 statement. It is the end of a sentence about targeted investments to drive down everyday costs (rent, health care access for lower-income Oregonians, child care costs). Statement reworded to say so; year retained.

positions.statement: In a March 2022 statement as Senate Majority Leader, Wagner said the session's work to build an economy for working families and small businesses meant reducing barriers to people starting and expanding small business.
positions.excerpt: It meant reducing barriers to people starting and expanding small business.

source.url: https://www.oregonlegislature.gov/senatedemocrats/Documents/Senate Majority Leader Rob Wagner Statement on Adjournment of the 2022 Legislative Session.pdf

verification.note: Quote confirmed in the March 4, 2022 statement. The sentence says building an economy that works for working families and small businesses 'meant reducing barriers to people starting and expanding small business'; it does not say 'legislation included'. Reworded to the statement's wording; year retained.
